size_pipe.description: The 'SIZE PIPE' (leftmost) column of the casing/tubing record grid on page 2 (the table just below 'Was well shot?', with column headers SIZE PIPE | PUT IN WELL (Ft./In.) | PULLED OUT (Ft./In.) | LEFT IN WELL (Ft./In.) | PACKERS AND SHOES). Gives the diameter of the pipe/casing string this row describes (e.g. '7"'). This cell is the row identity. Extract the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed, preserving fractions and any inch mark; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the PUT IN WELL / PULLED OUT / LEFT IN WELL footage columns of the same row, nor with the PACKERS AND SHOES column.
size_pipe.title: Size Pipe

put_in_well_ft.description: The 'PUT IN WELL' > 'Ft.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the whole-feet portion of the depth this size of pipe was put in the well. Printed unit is ft.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'PUT IN WELL > In.' inches sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PULLED OUT > Ft.' or 'LEFT IN WELL > Ft.' columns to the right.
put_in_well_ft.title: Put In Well Ft

put_in_well_in.description: The 'PUT IN WELL' > 'In.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the inches portion of the depth this size of pipe was put in the well. Printed unit is in.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'PUT IN WELL > Ft.' feet sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PULLED OUT > In.' or 'LEFT IN WELL > In.' columns to the right.
put_in_well_in.title: Put In Well In

pulled_out_ft.description: The 'PULLED OUT' > 'Ft.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the whole-feet portion of the length of this pipe that was pulled out of the well. Printed unit is ft.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'PULLED OUT > In.' inches sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PUT IN WELL > Ft.' (to the left) or 'LEFT IN WELL > Ft.' (to the right) columns.
pulled_out_ft.title: Pulled Out Ft

pulled_out_in.description: The 'PULLED OUT' > 'In.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the inches portion of the length of this pipe that was pulled out of the well. Printed unit is in.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'PULLED OUT > Ft.' feet sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PUT IN WELL > In.' (to the left) or 'LEFT IN WELL > In.' (to the right) columns.
pulled_out_in.title: Pulled Out In

left_in_well_ft.description: The 'LEFT IN WELL' > 'Ft.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the whole-feet portion of the length of this pipe left in the well. Printed unit is ft.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'LEFT IN WELL > In.' inches sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PUT IN WELL > Ft.' or 'PULLED OUT > Ft.' columns to the left.
left_in_well_ft.title: Left In Well Ft

left_in_well_in.description: The 'LEFT IN WELL' > 'In.' sub-column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: the inches portion of the length of this pipe left in the well. Printed unit is in.; include the unit only if it is written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'LEFT IN WELL > Ft.' feet sub-column in the same row, nor with the 'PUT IN WELL > In.' or 'PULLED OUT > In.' columns to the left.
left_in_well_in.title: Left In Well In

packers_and_shoes.description: The 'PACKERS AND SHOES' (rightmost) column for this row of the page-2 casing/tubing record grid: notes on any packers and casing shoes associated with this pipe string. Extract the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'SIZE PIPE' identity column or with the PUT IN WELL / PULLED OUT / LEFT IN WELL footage columns of the same row.
packers_and_shoes.title: Packers And Shoes

p1_file_no.description: The 'Please Refer to File No.' value in the top-left header of page 1 (the plugging-application page). The RRC file number assigned to this well, used as a reference. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving any leading zeros and casing; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No.' (the district number on the same page) or with the identically-labeled 'Please Refer to File No.' on page 2 (p2_file_no).
p1_file_no.title: Please Refer To File No

p1_district_no.description: The district number following the printed instruction 'FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No.' near the top of page 1: the RRC Oil and Gas Division district in which the well is located. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving any leading zeros or letter suffix; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Please Refer to File No.' (the file number on the same page) or with the identical district field on page 2 (p2_district_no).
p1_district_no.title: FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No

p1_company.description: The 'Company' field in the identification block on page 1: the name of the operator/company filing this plug application. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve casing, initials and punctuation); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Name of Party Plugging Well' (the plugging contractor) or the 'Correspondence ... Name' field on the same page, nor with the identical 'Company' field on page 2 (p2_company).
p1_company.title: Company

p1_address.description: The 'Address' field on the same line as 'Company' in the page-1 identification block: the mailing address of the company. Extract the full address verbatim as one string (preserve street, P.O. box, city, state as printed); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Name of Party Plugging Well > Address' or 'Correspondence ... Address' on the same page, nor with the page-2 'Address' (p2_address).
p1_address.title: Address

p1_sec_no.description: The 'Sec. No.' field in the page-1 land-description line: the survey section number where the well is located. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Block No.', 'Survey', 'Well No.' or 'No. of Acres' on the same line, nor with the identical 'Sec. No.' on page 2 (p2_sec_no).
p1_sec_no.title: Sec No

p1_block_no.description: The 'Block No.' field in the page-1 land-description line: the survey block identifier where the well is located. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Sec. No.' or 'Survey' on the same line, nor with the identical 'Block No.' on page 2 (p2_block_no).
p1_block_no.title: Block No

p1_survey.description: The 'Survey' field in the page-1 land-description line: the name or number of the abstract/grantee survey. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Sec. No.' or 'Block No.' on the same line, nor with the identical 'Survey' on page 2 (p2_survey).
p1_survey.title: Survey

p1_county.description: The 'County' field in the page-1 land-description line: the Texas county in which the well is located. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Name of field in which well is located' (the RRC field name) on the same page, nor with the page-2 'County' (p2_county) or the notary's 'County, Texas' on page 2.
p1_county.title: County

p1_well_no.description: The 'Well No.' field in the page-1 identification block: the well number/designation on the lease. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros and any letter suffix; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'No. of Acres', 'Sec. No.', or 'Please Refer to File No.' on the same page, nor with the identical 'Well No.' on page 2 (p2_well_no).
p1_well_no.title: Well No

p1_name_of_lease.description: The 'Name of Lease' field in the page-1 identification block: the lease name (may be prefixed by a lease/file number). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Name of field in which well is located' (the RRC field name), 'Company', or 'Well No.' on the same page, nor with the identical 'Name of Lease' on page 2 (p2_name_of_lease).
p1_name_of_lease.title: Name Of Lease

p1_no_of_acres.description: The 'No. of Acres' field in the page-1 land-description line: the number of acres in the lease/tract. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve any decimal); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Elev.' to its right, 'Sec. No.'/'Block No.', or 'Well No.' on the same line, nor with the identical 'No. of Acres' on page 2 (p2_no_of_acres).
p1_no_of_acres.title: No Of Acres

p1_elev.description: The 'Elev.' field in the page-1 land-description line (to the right of 'No. of Acres'): the ground/derrick-floor elevation of the well. Extract verbatim as printed (include any unit if written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'No. of Acres' to its left or 'Total Depth' on the same page, nor with the identical 'Elev.' on page 2 (p2_elev).
p1_elev.title: Elev

p1_name_of_field.description: The 'Name of field in which well is located' field on page 1: the RRC field/reservoir name (may include 'Regular'/'Wildcat'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'County' (the geographic county), 'Name of Lease', or 'Character of Well' on the same page, nor with the identical field-name on page 2 (p2_name_of_field).
p1_name_of_field.title: Name Of Field In Which Well Is Located

p1_located_miles.description: The mileage blank in the page-1 location sentence 'Located ____ Miles ____ Direction from ____ (Nearest P.O. or Town)': the distance value (printed unit miles). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Direction' blank (compass direction) or the 'from (Nearest P.O. or Town)' blank in the same sentence (p1_located_direction, p1_located_from).
p1_located_miles.title: Located Miles

p1_located_direction.description: The direction blank in the page-1 location sentence 'Located ____ Miles ____ Direction from ____ (Nearest P.O. or Town)': the compass direction text (e.g. 'South'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Miles' distance blank or the 'from (Nearest P.O. or Town)' town blank in the same sentence (p1_located_miles, p1_located_from).
p1_located_direction.title: Located Direction

p1_located_from.description: The town blank in the page-1 location sentence 'Located ____ Miles ____ Direction from ____ (Nearest P.O. or Town)': the nearest post office or town the distance/direction are measured from. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'County' or 'Name of field' on the same page, nor with the 'Miles'/'Direction' blanks of the same sentence.
p1_located_from.title: Located From Nearest P O Or Town

p1_form1_filed_in_name_of.description: The page-1 field 'Form 1, "Notice of Intention to Drill," was filed in name of': the name under which the original drilling-intent Form 1 was filed. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Company', 'Name of Party Plugging Well', or 'Name of Lease' on the same page, nor with the identical Form-1 field on page 2 (p2_form1_filed_in_name_of).
p1_form1_filed_in_name_of.title: Form 1 Notice Of Intention To Drill Was Filed In Name Of

p1_drilling_commenced.description: The 'Drilling Commenced' date on page 1 (the printed line reads 'Drilling Commenced ____, 19__'): the date drilling of the well began. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve the month/day/year tokens and the pre-printed '19' century prefix as written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Drilling Completed' (the completion date on the same line) or 'Date you wish to Plug' on the same page.
p1_drilling_commenced.title: Drilling Commenced

p1_drilling_completed.description: The 'Drilling Completed' date on page 1 (the printed line reads 'Drilling Completed ____, 19__'): the date drilling of the well finished. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve the month/day/year tokens and the pre-printed '19' century prefix as written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Drilling Commenced' (the start date to its left) or 'Date you wish to Plug' on the same page.
p1_drilling_completed.title: Drilling Completed

p1_ever_produced_oil.description: The 'oil' answer to the page-1 question 'Has this well ever produced oil? or Gas?': the answer written for oil (typically 'Yes'/'No'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired 'or Gas?' answer in the same question (p1_ever_produced_gas) or with 'Character of Well (Oil, Gas or Dry)' on the same page.
p1_ever_produced_oil.title: Ever Produced Oil

p1_ever_produced_gas.description: The 'or Gas?' answer to the page-1 question 'Has this well ever produced oil? or Gas?': the answer written for gas (typically 'Yes'/'No'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired oil answer in the same question (p1_ever_produced_oil) or with the page-2 'Has this well ever produced oil or gas?' (p2_ever_produced_oil_or_gas).
p1_ever_produced_gas.title: Ever Produced Gas

p1_character_of_well.description: The 'Character of Well (Oil, Gas or Dry)' field on page 1: the classification of the well written by the operator (e.g. 'Oil', 'Gas', 'Dry'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-2 'Character of Well at the time of completion' (which is split into separate Oil/Gas/Dry value fields, p2_completion_*), nor with 'Has this well ever produced oil? or Gas?' on the same page.
p1_character_of_well.title: Character Of Well Oil Gas Or Dry

p1_total_depth.description: The 'Total Depth' field on page 1: the total measured depth of the well (printed unit feet). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Elev.' on the same page, nor with the page-2 'Total Depth' (p2_total_depth) or 'Top of each producing sand' depth.
p1_total_depth.title: Total Depth

p1_date_wish_to_plug.description: The 'Date you wish to Plug' field on page 1 (the printed line reads 'Date you wish to Plug ____, 19__'): the requested/intended plugging date. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve the date tokens and pre-printed '19' prefix as written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Drilling Commenced'/'Drilling Completed' on the same page, nor with the page-2 'Date well was plugged' (p2_date_well_plugged), which is the actual plugging date.
p1_date_wish_to_plug.title: Date You Wish To Plug

p1_party_plugging_well.description: The 'Name of Party Plugging Well' field on page 1: the name of the party/contractor who will plug the well. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Company' (the operator) or the 'Correspondence ... Name' field on the same page, and do NOT confuse with this field's own 'Address' sub-field (p1_party_plugging_address).
p1_party_plugging_well.title: Name Of Party Plugging Well

p1_party_plugging_address.description: The 'Address' sub-field of 'Name of Party Plugging Well' on page 1: the mailing address of the plugging party. Extract the full address verbatim as one string; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-1 'Company > Address' (p1_address) or the 'Correspondence ... Address' field (p1_correspondence_address) on the same page.
p1_party_plugging_address.title: Name Of Party Plugging Well Address

p1_correspondence_name.description: The 'Name' sub-field under 'Correspondence regarding this well should be sent to:' on page 1: the contact name for correspondence. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Company' or 'Name of Party Plugging Well' on the same page, with this block's own 'Address' (p1_correspondence_address), nor with the page-2 correspondence 'Name' (p2_correspondence_name).
p1_correspondence_name.title: Correspondence Name

p1_correspondence_address.description: The 'Address' sub-field under 'Correspondence regarding this well should be sent to:' on page 1: the mailing address for correspondence. Extract the full address verbatim as one string; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Company > Address' or 'Name of Party Plugging Well > Address' on the same page, with this block's own 'Name' (p1_correspondence_name), nor with the page-2 correspondence 'Address' (p2_correspondence_address).
p1_correspondence_address.title: Correspondence Address

p1_init_prod_gas_volume.description: The 'Volume (MCF)' sub-field under 'Initial Production of Gas:' on page 1: the initial gas production volume (printed unit MCF). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed (a value such as 'nil' may be written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the '24 hrs. Pressure' sub-field of the same 'Initial Production of Gas' block (p1_init_prod_gas_pressure) or with 'Initial Production of Oil > Barrels' (p1_init_prod_oil_barrels).
p1_init_prod_gas_volume.title: Initial Production Of Gas Volume MCF

p1_init_prod_gas_pressure.description: The '24 hrs. Pressure' sub-field under 'Initial Production of Gas:' on page 1: the 24-hour shut-in/flowing pressure (printed unit lbs. per square inch). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Volume (MCF)' sub-field of the same gas block (p1_init_prod_gas_volume) or with 'Initial Production of Oil > Barrels' (p1_init_prod_oil_barrels).
p1_init_prod_gas_pressure.title: Initial Production Of Gas 24 Hrs Pressure

p1_init_prod_oil_barrels.description: The 'Barrels' sub-field under 'Initial Production of Oil:' on page 1: the initial oil production in barrels (printed unit barrels). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Initial Production of Gas' sub-fields (Volume (MCF) / 24 hrs. Pressure) above it on the same page.
p1_init_prod_oil_barrels.title: Initial Production Of Oil Barrels

p1_general_remarks.description: The 'General Remarks:' free-text block at the bottom of page 1 (above the note 'FILL OUT FORMATION AND AFFIDAVIT ON REVERSE SIDE'): any free-form remarks the operator adds. Extract the entire text verbatim as one string; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-2 narrative fields such as 'Manner of confining all oil, gas or water to strata' or 'show all shoulders left for casing...' (p2_plugs_detail).
p1_general_remarks.title: General Remarks

p2_file_no.description: The 'Please Refer to File No.' value in the header of page 2 (the Well Record / plugging-record reverse side). The RRC file number for this well as written on page 2. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No.' on page 2 (p2_district_no) or with the identically-labeled file number on page 1 (p1_file_no).
p2_file_no.title: Please Refer To File No

p2_district_no.description: The district number following 'FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No.' in the header of page 2: the RRC Oil and Gas Division district. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros or letter suffix; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Please Refer to File No.' on page 2 (p2_file_no) or with the identical district field on page 1 (p1_district_no).
p2_district_no.title: FILE IN DUPLICATE WITH DEPUTY SUPERVISOR OF DISTRICT No

p2_company.description: The 'Company' field in the identification block at the top of page 2: the operator/company name repeated on the well-record page. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-2 affidavit/correspondence names, nor with the identical 'Company' field on page 1 (p1_company).
p2_company.title: Company

p2_address.description: The 'Address' field on the same line as 'Company' in the page-2 identification block: the company mailing address. Extract the full address verbatim as one string; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-2 correspondence 'Address' (p2_correspondence_address), nor with the identical 'Address' field on page 1 (p1_address).
p2_address.title: Address

p2_sec_no.description: The 'Sec. No.' field in the page-2 land-description line: the survey section number. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Block No.' or 'Survey' on the same page-2 line, nor with the identical 'Sec. No.' on page 1 (p1_sec_no).
p2_sec_no.title: Sec No

p2_block_no.description: The 'Block No.' field in the page-2 land-description line: the survey block identifier. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Sec. No.' or 'Survey' on the same page-2 line, nor with the identical 'Block No.' on page 1 (p1_block_no).
p2_block_no.title: Block No

p2_survey.description: The 'Survey' field in the page-2 land-description line: the abstract/grantee survey name or number. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Sec. No.' or 'Block No.' on the same page-2 line, nor with the identical 'Survey' on page 1 (p1_survey).
p2_survey.title: Survey

p2_county.description: The 'County' field in the page-2 land-description line: the Texas county in which the well is located. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the notary's 'County, Texas' near the affidavit (p2_notary_county), with 'Name of field in which well is located' on the same page, nor with the identical 'County' on page 1 (p1_county).
p2_county.title: County

p2_well_no.description: The 'Well No.' field in the page-2 identification block: the well number/designation on the lease. Extract verbatim as printed, preserving leading zeros and any letter suffix; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'No. of Acres' or 'Sec. No.' on the same page, nor with the identical 'Well No.' on page 1 (p1_well_no).
p2_well_no.title: Well No

p2_name_of_lease.description: The 'Name of Lease' field in the page-2 identification block: the lease name. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Name of field in which well is located' (the RRC field name) on the same page, nor with the identical 'Name of Lease' on page 1 (p1_name_of_lease).
p2_name_of_lease.title: Name Of Lease

p2_no_of_acres.description: The 'No. of Acres' field in the page-2 identification block: the number of acres in the lease/tract. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve any decimal); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-2 'Elev.' field (p2_elev) that follows it, with depth or footage values on the page, nor with the identical 'No. of Acres' on page 1 (p1_no_of_acres).
p2_no_of_acres.title: No Of Acres

p2_elev.description: The 'Elev.' (elevation) field in the page-2 identification block: the ground/derrick-floor elevation of the well as recorded on the well-record page. Extract verbatim as printed (include any unit if written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'No. of Acres' to its left, with 'Total Depth' or 'Top of each producing sand' on page 2, nor with the identical 'Elev.' on page 1 (p1_elev).
p2_elev.title: Elev

p2_name_of_field.description: The 'Name of field in which well is located' field on page 2: the RRC field/reservoir name (may include 'Regular'/'Wildcat'). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'County' or 'Name of Lease' on the same page, nor with the identical field-name on page 1 (p1_name_of_field).
p2_name_of_field.title: Name Of Field In Which Well Is Located

p2_form1_filed_in_name_of.description: The page-2 field 'Form 1 (Notice of Intention to Drill) Was Filed in Name of': the name under which the original drilling-intent Form 1 was filed, repeated on the well-record page. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Company' or the affidavit/correspondence names on the same page, nor with the identical Form-1 field on page 1 (p1_form1_filed_in_name_of).
p2_form1_filed_in_name_of.title: Form 1 Notice Of Intention To Drill Was Filed In Name Of

p2_date_well_plugged.description: The 'Date well was plugged' field on page 2 (the printed line reads 'Date well was plugged ____, 19__'): the actual date the well was plugged. Extract verbatim as printed (preserve the date tokens and the pre-printed '19' prefix as written); null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the page-1 'Date you wish to Plug' (the intended date, p1_date_wish_to_plug) or with the affidavit 'Subscribed and sworn to before me this' date on page 2 (p2_sworn_*).
p2_date_well_plugged.title: Date Well Was Plugged

p2_completion_oil.description: The 'Oil' value in the page-2 line 'Character of Well at the time of completion: Oil ____ bbls; Gas ____ Cu. Ft.; Dry ____ (Initial Production)': the oil rate at completion (printed unit bbls). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the sibling 'Gas' and 'Dry' completion values (p2_completion_gas, p2_completion_dry), nor with the 'Amount well producing when plugged > Oil' value (p2_amount_plugged_oil) on the next line.
p2_completion_oil.title: Character Of Well At Time Of Completion Oil

p2_completion_gas.description: The 'Gas' value in the page-2 line 'Character of Well at the time of completion: Oil ____ bbls; Gas ____ Cu. Ft.; Dry ____ (Initial Production)': the gas rate at completion (printed unit Cu. Ft.). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the sibling 'Oil' and 'Dry' completion values (p2_completion_oil, p2_completion_dry), nor with the 'Amount well producing when plugged > Gas' value (p2_amount_plugged_gas) on the next line.
p2_completion_gas.title: Character Of Well At Time Of Completion Gas

p2_completion_dry.description: The 'Dry' value in the page-2 line 'Character of Well at the time of completion: Oil ____ bbls; Gas ____ Cu. Ft.; Dry ____ (Initial Production)': the entry indicating a dry hole at completion (e.g. 'No' or a mark). Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the sibling 'Oil' and 'Gas' completion values (p2_completion_oil, p2_completion_gas) on the same line, nor with the page-1 'Character of Well (Oil, Gas or Dry)' single field (p1_character_of_well).
p2_completion_dry.title: Character Of Well At Time Of Completion Dry

p2_amount_plugged_oil.description: The 'Oil' value in the page-2 line 'Amount well producing when plugged: Oil ____ bbls; Gas ____ Cu. Ft.; Water ____ bbls.': the oil production rate at the time of plugging (printed unit bbls). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the sibling 'Gas' and 'Water' amounts (p2_amount_plugged_gas, p2_amount_plugged_water), nor with the 'Character of Well at the time of completion > Oil' value (p2_completion_oil) on the line above.
p2_amount_plugged_oil.title: Amount Well Producing When Plugged Oil

p2_amount_plugged_gas.description: The 'Gas' value in the page-2 line 'Amount well producing when plugged: Oil ____ bbls; Gas ____ Cu. Ft.; Water ____ bbls.': the gas production rate at the time of plugging (printed unit Cu. Ft.). Include the unit only if written in the cell. Extract verbatim as printed; null if blank. Do NOT confuse with the sibling 'Oil' and 'Water' amounts (p2_amount_plugged_oil, p2_amount_plugged_water), nor with the 'Character of Well at the time of completion > Gas' value (p2_completion_gas) on the line above.
